description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport class, which implements the EndpointAwareReport interface to generate a leave entitlement and usage report within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for report header and filter definitions, data retrieval, validation rules, and access control logic.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport
classes.description: This class generates a report on employee leave entitlements and usage, providing methods for report headers, filters, data retrieval, validation, and access control within the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the report header columns such as Leave Type, Entitlements, Pending Approval, Scheduled, Taken, and Balance with localized names.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new filter object for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns filter parameters, including employee number and date range, based on incoming request and current leave period.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for request parameters, including employee number and date filters, with sorting and pagination rules.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks user's permissions and leave period configuration to determine if the report can be accessed; throws exceptions if not authorized or leave period is undefined.
